modeReason: The chip maker CEO's resignation, record $1T+ stock loss, and new congressional probe (novelty 3 x magnitude 3 x breadth 3 = 27) far exceed the fresh threshold of 8 for an industry story; the schools moratorium backlash and FAA rollout also independently clear the 5 threshold for non-industry stories.
phrase: A chip maker's chief resigned over an affair with an alleged foreign intelligence contact, erasing a trillion dollars. The same day, a search giant launched a smarter chatbot model.
phraseAlternatives: A chip maker's boss quit amid an affair scandal as markets erased a trillion dollars, while lawmakers opened a fresh investigation into the company's dealings with China.
While a chip maker's scandal wiped out a trillion dollars in value, families asked schools to pause a chatbot linked to a teenager's death.
A chip maker's longtime chief stepped down after an affair with an alleged intelligence contact, as the company lost over a trillion dollars overnight.

brief.concept: A chip maker's chief executive walks out the door as the company's stock craters, while across town a calm AI robot rolls a brand-new model off the assembly line like nothing happened.
brief.metaphor: A toppled company sign beside an assembly line that keeps running without a pause.

cast.who: a company building with its door open and its nameplate knocked askew
a departing tech executive walking out, suitcase in hand
a falling stock arrow piercing a cracked chart beside the building
a small AI robot calmly rolling a shiny new gear off a conveyor belt

brief.composition: Split horizontal composition on a fine blueprint grid. Left half: a leaning company building with its door open, a human figure walking out holding a suitcase, its nameplate tipped over at the base, and a stock arrow plunging through a cracked chart at its feet. Right half: a small AI robot on an assembly line calmly rolling a shiny new gear forward, one yellow highlight on the gear marking the joke. A thin dividing line separates the chaos from the calm.
brief.alt: A leaning company building with its door open and a human figure walking out carrying a suitcase, its nameplate fallen and a stock arrow plunging through a cracked chart beside it. Next to it, a small robot calmly rolls a shiny new gear off a conveyor belt, unbothered.
